The 'Northeast' is expected to experience rain for most of the night, with some areas in 'New York' and 'Vermont' potentially seeing snow. The 'Great Lakes' region could see up to 'two feet' of additional 'lake-effect snow' through 'Tuesday morning'. The cold temperatures in the 'East' are not expected to dissipate soon. The storm caused significant travel disruptions over the weekend, including stranding motorists and delaying flights. At least two counties in 'northwest Indiana' declared a 'state of emergency', urging drivers to avoid travel unless absolutely necessary. The storm's impact was not limited to the 'Midwest', with 'winter weather notices' issued for parts of 'Indiana', 'Ohio', 'Kentucky', 'Tennessee', 'Pennsylvania', 'New York', and 'New England'.

article_content: A former solicitor, Tony Johnson, put an antique Chinese vase up for auction in 2010 and has now sold it after a lengthy legal dispute. Johnson and his mother Gene initially believed they had sold the 18th-century Qianlong vase for £43million. The Chinese billionaire buyer refused to pay due to a dispute over a 20% auctioneer's fee. After a two-year stalemate, a new buyer from the Far East purchased the vase for £25million through Bonhams. Separately, a Chinese table screen sold for £34,300 at Addison's Auction House, far exceeding its original price of £150.

Tony Johnson dhe nëna e tij Gene kishin menduar se kishin shitur vazën e rrallë të shekullit të 18-të Qianlong për 43 milionë paund në 2010. Blërësi kinez miliardër nuk pranoi të paguante për shkak të një dispute mbi tarifën 20% të ankandit. article_content: Netflix is set to increase its monthly subscription fees for customers in the United States, the United Kingdom, and France. The basic ad-free plan, priced at '$9.99', will rise to '$11.99', and the premium plan will increase from '$19.99' to '$22.99'. The ad-supported plan at '$6.99' and the standard ad-free plan at '$15.49' will remain unchanged. This adjustment follows Netflix's largest quarterly subscriber growth since '2020', attributed to its crackdown on password-sharing. The company's shares rose '12%' after exceeding analysts' earnings expectations. Mark Schilsky from Bernstein Research had predicted Netflix would use its 'significant untapped pricing power'. This is Netflix's first price hike since January '2022', when it adjusted its standard and premium plans.

Plani me mbështetje reklamash që kushton '$6.99' dhe plani standard pa reklama që kushton '$15.49' do të mbeten të pandryshuar. Ky ndryshim pason rritjen më të madhe tremujore të abonentëve që nga '2020', e atribuar përpjekjeve për të kufizuar ndarjen e fjalëkalimeve. Aksionet e kompanisë u rritën '12%' pasi tejkaluan pritshmëritë e analistëve për fitimet. Mark Schilsky nga Bernstein Research kishte parashikuar se Netflix do të përdorte 'fuqinë e tij të konsiderueshme çmimore të papërdorur'. Kjo është rritja e parë e çmimit nga Netflix që nga janari '2022', kur u bënë ndryshimet në planet standarde dhe premium.

article_content: Lillo Brancato Jr., known for his role in 'The Sopranos,' was acquitted of murdering an off-duty New York police officer in 2005, but was found guilty of attempted burglary. Brancato, aged 32, was cleared of burglary charges and the murder of Officer Daniel Enchautegui. The actor's attorney, Joseph Tacopina, noted that Brancato had already served three years. Brancato testified that he and Steven Armento were looking for valium and claimed to have the homeowner's permission to take painkillers. Armento received a life sentence for shooting Enchautegui. Brancato faces three to 15 years for attempted burglary.

Brancato përballet me tre deri në 15 vjet burg për tentativë vjedhjeje.

article_content: At Budapest Zoo, a crow's life was saved by a grizzly bear when it fell into the bear's enclosure pond. The crow was drowning when Vali, the female grizzly bear, discovered it and pulled it to safety. The incident was captured on video by a visitor earlier this summer and later uploaded to YouTube. In the video, Vali is seen approaching the pond after noticing the crow flailing in the water. She initially tries to pull the crow out with her paw, then bites the crow's wing to drag it to safety. The crow, in a defensive response, bites Vali on the nose, causing her to release her grip. After being rescued, the crow appears shocked but manages to get back on its feet. Budapest Zoo commented that Vali was likely just curious and didn't intend to save the crow.

Incidenti u filmua nga një vizitor dhe u ngarkua në YouTube. Në video, Vali shkon drejt pellgut pasi sheh sorrën duke u përpjekur. Ajo së pari përpiqet ta nxjerrë me kthetfë, pastaj e kafshon krahun e saj për ta nxjerrë. Sorrë e kafshon Valin në hundë dhe ajo e lëshon. Sorrë duket e shokuar por më pas ngrihet në këmbë. article_content: By Wills Robinson and Daily Mail Reporter. PUBLISHED: 12:11 EST, 16 October 2013 | UPDATED: 01:50 EST, 17 October 2013. A deaf and mute girl was trafficked into Britain by an elderly couple to act as a sex slave. She was ten years old when she was taken from her home in Pakistan to serve 'evil' businessman Ilyas Ashar, 84, and his wife Tallat, 67. Forced to sleep in the cellar, she was repeatedly raped by Ashar. She was also forced to carry out all menial chores in the £300,000 house. Ashar was found guilty of 13 charges of rape at Manchester Crown Court, while his wife Tallat was found guilty of two counts of trafficking a person into the UK for exploitation and four counts of furnishing false information to obtain benefits. The girl, now 20, recalls meeting the Ashars in Pakistan and putting her thumbprint on a document believed to be her passport. She arrived in the UK on June 24, 2000, with her passport stating she was 19. Initially, she was given gifts, but soon she was asked to work and became the couple's personal domestic slave. For up to nine years, she slept on a concrete floor in the cellar and was regularly berated about her work. The girl spent 49 days giving testimony by video link in a private room, accompanied by interpreters. The Ashars were convicted of trafficking for exploitation and benefit fraud. Ashar was separately convicted of 13 charges of rape.

article_content: A father shot his daughter before taking his own life because he feared they couldn't cope with the death of her mother, an inquest heard. Pauline Barker, 56, was found drowned in the River Trent near Colwick, Nottingham, on April 15, 2012. Her former partner, Archie McKelvie, 64, believed neither he nor their daughter, Corrin Barker, 31, could cope with the loss. The coroner, Mairin Casey, concluded that Archie McKelvie planned to shoot Corrin and then himself. The inquest heard Pauline Barker had suffered from mental health problems and depression.

Hetimi në gjykatë dëgjoi se Pauline Barker kishte probleme me shëndetin mendor dhe depresion.

article_content: Mo Farah has withdrawn from the upcoming Great Edinburgh XCountry international challenge citing health issues. The Olympic champion in the 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters was set to represent Great Britain and Northern Ireland against teams from the United States and Europe at Holyrood Park. Farah stated to Athletics Weekly: 'I've had to cancel my participation due to battling the flu over the Christmas and New Year holidays, which forced me to take a break from training.' His focus for 2015 remains the IAAF World T&F Championships in Beijing, where he aims to defend his titles in the 5,000m and 10,000m events.

Farah i tha Athletics Weekly: 'Kam pasur nevojë të anuloj pjesëmarrjen time pasi u sëmura me grip gjatë festave të Krishtlindjeve dhe Vitit të Ri, duke më detyruar të bëj një pushim nga stërvitjet.' Objektivi i tij kryesor për 2015 mbetet Kampionati Botëror i IAAF në Pekin, ku synon të mbrojë titujt e tij në garat 5,000m dhe 10,000m.

article_content: Wolf Blitzer, CNN's lead political anchor, has lived in the Washington area for 39 years. 'It's a wonderful place to live and visit,' he said, highlighting its historical significance and cultural attractions like the Kennedy Center and museums. He humorously notes that tourists stand out in the summer due to their comfortable shorts and T-shirts. He unwinds in his backyard and enjoys spending a night out at a Washington Nationals baseball game with friends. Blitzer suggests trying eggplant parmigiana and white pizza at Pines of Rome in Bethesda. While appreciating all the city's attractions, he has a special fondness for the Lincoln Memorial and Jefferson Memorial. For souvenirs, he advises checking out the Smithsonian gift shops.

article_content: Atlanta (CNN) -- On Monday, I signed an online petition supporting President Obama, Warren Buffett, and others in urging Congress to pass the Buffett Rule. The Buffett Rule requires the wealthiest Americans to pay taxes at rates not less than those paid by middle-income Americans, closing loopholes that allow millionaires and billionaires to have unfairly low tax rates. This year, various events have highlighted fairness, including Obama's State of the Union address and the Trayvon Martin case. My parents taught me that fairness means 'playing fair' and 'not cheating,' values that were clear even during segregation. However, I've encountered a different definition of 'fair' -- 'fair is when I win' -- a self-centered view. Obama's State of the Union message emphasized restoring an economy where everyone gets a fair shot and plays by the same rules. I've seen people who benefited from personal connections protest when others receive opportunities, showing a skewed sense of fairness. As a corporate executive, I believed affordable, quality healthcare for all was 'only fair.' The flames of innovation are snuffed out when people feel they don't have a fair shot. Langston Hughes' poem 'Dream Deferred' asks what happens to a deferred dream, and I pray for strength to fight for what's fair.

article_content: A Florida physician's assistant was jailed on Thursday after refusing to move his car, blocking a medical helicopter's access to the scene of a deadly car crash, police say. James Allen, 52, drove around emergency vehicles at the Barberville accident scene that left 26-year-old Tessa George dead. He then parked in the area cleared for the helicopter and refused to move, despite police pleas and the helicopter hovering 50-100 feet above. Authorities report that rescuers responded to a crash that occurred early Thursday. George, a bartender from Ormond Beach, overcorrected and crashed her SUV into a tree. Officials blocked traffic and called in a helicopter to assess the occupants' condition. As traffic backed up, Allen drove around emergency vehicles and refused to stop despite police orders. Only when Allen was forced to move his car could the helicopter land. He continued to refuse to produce his driver's license and was later arrested. Allen claimed he was 'confused about what all the fuss was over.' Police charged him with failure to obey police and fire department orders and resisting an officer without violence. He was released on his own recognizance on Friday.

article_content: A former U.S. Army major, John Jackson, and his wife Carolyn Jackson, were sentenced for abusing their foster children. Carolyn Jackson was sentenced to nearly 12 years in prison, while John Jackson received 9 years. The couple was found guilty of routinely beating the children and denying them food and water as punishment. U.S. District Judge Susan Wigenton, who took over the case after U.S. District Judge Katharine Hayden was found to have been too lenient in previous sentencings, imposed the terms. The case was complicated due to jurisdictional issues since the Jacksons lived at Picatinny Arsenal, a New Jersey military facility. Testimony during the trial revealed the children's severe physical condition, including broken bones and being severely underweight. The Jacksons' biological son testified that the couple forced the children to eat hot pepper flakes and drink hot sauce as punishment.

However, one child died last year, highlighting the need for safer packaging. Some manufacturers have revised packaging to make detergent packets safer.

Rastet vijnë nga mbi 17,000 thirrje në qendrat e kontrollit të helmimeve në dy vitet e fundit. Thirrjet përfshinin fëmijë nën gjashtë vjeç, dhe shumica nuk u dëmtuan rëndë.

article_content: Three thousand years ago, Britons in East Anglia were skilled boat builders and sailors, enjoyed fishing, and the occasional bowl of 'nettle stew' - and used a method of 'eel trapping' still used today. They even used 'wooden cutlery'. This incredible, detailed picture of life three millennia ago is thanks to a haul of Bronze Age boats, spears, swords, and clothing unearthed at one of the most significant Bronze Age sites ever found in Britain, on the River Nene, at Must Farm quarry, Whittlesey.

Ata madje përdornin 'lugë druri'. Kjo pamje e jashtëzakonshme dhe e detajuar e jetës tre mijëvjeçarë më parë është falë një gërmimi të epokës së bronzit, me anije, shtiza, shpata, dhe veshje të zbuluara në një nga vendet më të rëndësishme të epokës së bronzit të gjetura ndonjëherë në Britani, në lumin Nene, në guroren Must Farm, Whittlesey.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- Former Soviet spy Oleg Kalugin, who headed KGB operations in the US in the 1970s and later moved to America, told CNN he's 'amazed' that Moscow is engaging heavily in espionage against Washington. Reacting to the arrests of 11 alleged Russian spies, Kalugin said the information they collected 'does not require such a massive assault' against the US. Kalugin called it a sign of 'decadence' in Russian intelligence services. The Justice Department announced that 10 people were arrested in the US on charges of being Russian spies. An 11th suspect was arrested in Cyprus. Their mission was 'to become sufficiently Americanized' to gather US information and recruit sources within US policy-making circles.

Duke iu referuar arrestimeve të 11 spiunëve të supozuar rusë, Kalugin tha se informacioni që ata mbledhën 'nuk kërkon një sulm kaq masiv' kundër SHBA-së. Kalugin e quajti atë një shenjë të 'dekadencës' në shërbimet e inteligjencës ruse. Departamenti i Drejtësisë njoftoi se 10 persona u arrestuan në SHBA për të qenë spiunë rusë. Një i dyshuar i 11-të u arrestua në Qipro. Misioni i tyre ishte 'të amerikanizoheshin' për të mbledhur informacion dhe për të rekrutuar burime brenda qarqeve vendimmarrëse amerikane.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- An alleged Somali pirate leader, Mohammad Saaili Shibin, has been indicted for the takeover of the yacht 'Quest' and the kidnapping of four Americans who were subsequently killed. Shibin, 50, appeared in federal court in Norfolk, Virginia, after the indictment was unsealed. U.S. Attorney Neil MacBride stated that this is the first time the U.S. government has captured and charged an alleged pirate in a leadership role. According to the indictment, Shibin negotiated the terms for the release of the four Americans and conducted Internet research to determine the ransom and identify the hostages' family members. Shibin and 14 co-conspirators are charged with piracy, conspiracy to commit kidnapping, and firearm use during a crime of violence, facing life in prison if convicted.

Shibin, 50 vjeç, u paraqit në gjykatën federale në Norfolk, Virginia, pasi akuza u bë publike. Prokurori i SHBA-së, Neil MacBride, tha se kjo është hera e parë që qeveria e SHBA-së ka kapur dhe akuzuar një pirat të supozuar në rol udhëheqës. Sipas aktakuzës, Shibin negocioi kushtet për lirimin e katër amerikanëve dhe kreu kërkime në internet për të përcaktuar shpërblimin dhe për të identifikuar anëtarët e familjes së pengjeve. A study by the Equal Opportunities Commission found that 27% of Hong Kong-based attendants experienced sexual harassment on flights in the past year. article_content: Workers at a Denver 'Yard House' restaurant were surprised to discover a vagrant living in the rafters after he fell through the ceiling on Tuesday night, causing a flood. Denver police were called to the 'Yard House' on Court Street at around 11pm to report an intruder who had fallen from the rafters. The individual, identified as 36-year-old Steven Graves, was found walking around the scaffolding upon the officers' arrival. Upon investigation, police discovered evidence in the ceiling, including multiple bottle caps, suggesting Graves had been living there for some time. Graves was later found trapped in a wall near the restaurant's entrance, with only his feet visible, and was rescued by firefighters using a chainsaw. The incident caused significant damage due to a ruptured water main, flooding the 'Yard House' and the lobby of the adjacent 'Sheraton Hotel'. Graves was hospitalized for his injuries before being booked into jail on charges of burglary and criminal mischief. Despite the incident, the 'Yard House' reopened for lunch the following day.

Individi, i identifikuar si Steven Graves 36-vjeçar, u gjet duke ecur rreth skelës pas mbërritjes së oficerëve. Graves më vonë u gjet i bllokuar në një mur pranë hyrjes së restorantit, me vetëm këmbët e tij të dukshme, dhe u shpëtua nga zjarrfikësit duke përdorur një sharrë elektrike. article_content: Mario Kempes, Argentina's legendary striker, has had heart surgery in the US. The 60-year-old icon had a six-bypass operation in Connecticut and is now in intensive care. Kempes is celebrated for his role in Argentina's 1978 World Cup win, where he topped the scoring charts with six goals. He netted two goals in the final against Holland, helping Argentina win 3-1. Kempes scored 20 goals in 43 matches for Argentina and played for Valencia in Spain. As an ESPN commentator, Kempes had recently stated that tests revealed he had 'very clogged arteries,' necessitating surgery.

Kempes njihet për kontributin e tij në fitoren e Argjentinës në Kupën e Botës 1978, ku ishte golashënuesi më i mirë me gjashtë gola. Ai shënoi dy gola në finale kundër Hollandës, duke i mundësuar Argjentinës të fitonte 3-1. Kempes ka shënuar 20 gola në 43 paraqitje për Argjentinën dhe ka luajtur për Valencia në Spanjë. I couldn't yet pronounce either of his real names (Seung or Yong), and although his friends called him 'Sing,' I stuck with the catchphrase my girlfriends and I had coined the first time I met him because, frankly, my nickname captured his presence better. I had come around to a slight Americanization of his real name by the first time we exchanged 'I love yous,' but it seemed of little consequence when Seung then added that I would never be welcome in his family's home. Seung had been told, all his life, more or less, that he was not allowed to marry someone like me. Pronunciation aside, it hadn't occurred to me that Seung and I made a mismatched couple. Mixed-race yes, but I couldn't fathom that my race could make me the 'wrong kind of girl' for anyone. Yes, it was white privilege that blinded me to the fact I might be the bottom of the barrel on someone else's race card. Perhaps even more so because I have been listening to the dialogue about how to make America more post-racial -- mostly as it pertains to black and white culture -- for so long that it never occurred to me that an Asian immigrant family might cry foul when their son fell in love with an all-American girl like me. But truthfully, I was blindsided for personal reasons, too. Years before this, I had fought with my own mother over our family's prejudices when it came to love. I had more than one black boyfriend in my twenties, and a few others in shades between olive and dark brown. When my parents said that one of them shouldn't be invited to our holiday table, I stopped showing up also. That particular boyfriend and I only lasted six months, but I did not visit home for nearly two years until my mother and I agreed that unconditional love meant accepting anyone, of any race, who I chose to spend my life with. I don't think I took such a stance with my family because I am Joan of Arc incarnate. Rather, aside from this flaw, my parents are kind and generous people. Parents often have a favorite child. I knew their prejudices came from the ignorance of confusing economics, education, and opportunity with culture. But they simultaneously taught me that I had a right to speak up for what I believed and to defend my choices. I only had the gumption to fight them and eventually end their narrow-mindedness because they showed me so much love. So, I found it particularly saddening to be back in the same mess, 15 years later, dressed in different robes. Even though Seung Yong's family is educated, well-traveled, and chose to raise their kids in the States. And even though, more to the point, Seung Yong was a grown man. 'You've never told your parents that you get to pick who you love?' I thought this but didn't say it out loud. Not at first, anyway. Instead, when he told me his parents would never let him be with a white girl, I stared into his eyes and smiled. Not because I was feeling his plight but because I'd become cautious of him. This man I had woken up with earlier in the day now seemed like a stranger to me. Specifically, he seemed like someone of another culture that I didn't know or understand. Which was, in fact, true, because as much as we had in common, I was completely unaware of what it meant to grow up Asian-American -- both in his home and in the outside world. But Seung kept talking, and what he was saying didn't allow me to recoil for too long. He wanted to be with me, no matter what. He had a plan for how he would address this issue with his parents, and he wondered if I was willing to take the leap with him. His words shut off the alarm bells in my head, and I agreed to follow him into the racially slurred forest where we would attempt to change what his parents, and so many, say in private to their kids about a mixed-race marriage. That turned out to be the most measured discussion Seung and I ever had about his family's belief that marrying me might degrade them by watering down their culture or bloodline. Because it was the only one in which I stayed silent. Using my words, gently and respectfully, in many, many, many subsequent conversations about how I felt did, in fact, lead Seung Yong and me to marry -- with the full support of all our parents. But it was only through continuous dialogue -- at the dinner table with friends who could advise us, and using calm voices in the bedroom with one another, and keeping an open mind on the couch at the therapist's office -- that we were able to find a way to make our familial cultures meet in the middle at our mutual American one. Seven years later and three half-Asian/half-Caucasian children deep, the discussion of race rarely comes up in our home. But only because we worked so hard to make sure the inconsistencies we were both taught in our parents' homes about what kinds of people were worthy to love would never be a part of our home or life together. The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of 'Diane Farr'.
translated_content: 'U ra në dashuri me 'Gjigantin Korean' në një dasmë të gjatë fundjave. Nuk mund ta shqiptoja ende njërin nga emrat e tij të vërtetë (Seung ose Yong), dhe megjithëse miqtë e tij e quanin 'Sing', unë mbaja frazën që unë dhe shoqet e mia kishim krijuar herën e parë që e takova sepse, sinqerisht, nofka ime kapte më mirë praninë e tij. Unë isha afruar me një amerikanizim të lehtë të emrit të tij të vërtetë nga hera e parë që shkëmbyem 'Të dua', por dukej pak rëndësi kur Seung më tha se nuk do të isha kurrë e mirëpritur në shtëpinë e familjes së tij. Seung ishte thënë, gjatë gjithë jetës së tij, pak a shumë, se nuk kishte leje të martohej me dikë si unë. Përveç shqiptimit, nuk më kishte shkuar ndërmend se Seung dhe unë bënim një çift të papërshtatshëm. Të përzier, po, por nuk mund ta kuptja që raca ime mund të më bënte 'vajzën e gabuar' për këdo. Po, ishte privilegji i bardhë që më verboi nga fakti se mund të isha në fund të fuçisë në kartën e racës së dikujt tjetër. Ndoshta edhe më shumë sepse kam dëgjuar dialogun se si ta bëjmë Amerikën më post-raciale -- kryesisht si i përket kulturës së zezë dhe të bardhë -- për kaq gjatë që nuk më kishte shkuar ndërmend se një familje e emigrantëve aziatikë mund të kundërshtonte kur djali i tyre ra në dashuri me një vajzë të gjitha-amerikane si unë. Por sinqerisht, unë u befasova edhe për arsye personale. Vite përpara kësaj, unë kisha luftuar me nënën time për paragjykimet e familjes sonë kur bëhej fjalë për dashurinë. Unë kisha pasur më shumë se një djalë të zi në të njëzetat e mia, dhe disa të tjerë në hije midis ullirit dhe kafe të errët. Kur prindërit e mi thanë se njëri prej tyre nuk duhet të ftohej në tryezën tonë të festave, unë ndalova së shkuari gjithashtu. Ai djalë i veçantë dhe unë zgjati vetëm gjashtë muaj, por unë nuk vizitova shtëpinë për gati dy vjet derisa nëna ime dhe unë ranë dakord se dashuria e pakushtëzuar nënkuptonte pranimin e kujtdo, të çdo race, që unë zgjodha të kaloja jetën time me të. Nuk mendoj se mora një qëndrim të tillë me familjen time sepse jam Joan e Arkut inkarnate. Përkundrazi, përveç kësaj të mete, prindërit e mi janë njerëz të mirë dhe bujarë. Prindërit shpesh kanë një fëmijë të preferuar. Unë dija se paragjykimet e tyre vinin nga injoranca e konfuzionit të ekonomisë, arsimit dhe mundësisë me kulturën. Por ata në të njëjtën kohë më mësuan se unë kisha të drejtë të flisja për atë që besoja dhe të mbroja zgjedhjet e mia. Unë vetëm pata guximin të luftoj me ta dhe në fund të mbaroja ngushtësinë e tyre sepse ata më treguan shumë dashuri. Kështu, unë e gjeta veçanërisht trishtuese të kthehesha në të njëjtin rrëmujë, 15 vjet më vonë, me veshje të ndryshme. Edhe pse familja e Seung Yong është e arsimuar, e udhëtuar mirë dhe zgjodhi të rritë fëmijët e tyre në Shtete. Dhe edhe pse, më shumë në pikë, Seung Yong ishte një burrë i rritur. 'A nuk i keni thënë kurrë prindërve tuaj se ju zgjidhni kë doni?' Mendoja këtë por nuk e thashë me zë të lartë. Jo në fillim, gjithsesi. Në vend të kësaj, kur ai më tha se prindërit e tij nuk do ta lejonin kurrë të ishte me një vajzë të bardhë, unë shikova në sytë e tij dhe buzëqesha. Jo sepse po ndija fatkeqësinë e tij, por sepse isha bërë e kujdesshme ndaj tij. Ky njeri me të cilin u zgjova më herët atë ditë tani dukej si një i huaj për mua. Në mënyrë specifike, ai dukej si dikush i një kulture tjetër që unë nuk e njihja ose kuptoja. E cila ishte, në fakt, e vërtetë, sepse aq sa kishim të përbashkët, unë isha plotësisht e pavetëdijshme se çfarë do të thoshte të rriteshit aziatiko-amerikan -- si në shtëpinë e tij ashtu edhe në botën e jashtme. Por Seung vazhdoi të fliste, dhe ajo që ai tha nuk më lejoi të zmbrapsem për shumë kohë. Ai donte të ishte me mua, sido që të ishte. Ai kishte një plan se si do ta trajtonte këtë çështje me prindërit e tij, dhe ai pyeti nëse unë isha e gatshme të hidhja hapin me të. Fjalët e tij çaktivizuan kambanat e alarmit në kokën time, dhe unë ra dakord të ndiqja atë në pyllin e shpifur raciste ku do të përpiqeshim të ndryshonim atë që prindërit e tij, dhe aq shumë të tjerë, thonë në privat për fëmijët e tyre për një martesë të përzier. Kjo doli të jetë diskutimi më i matur që Seung dhe unë patëm ndonjëherë për besimin e familjes së tij se martesa me mua mund t'i degradojë ata duke holluar kulturën ose gjakun e tyre. Sepse ishte e vetmja në të cilën unë heshta. Përdorimi i fjalëve të mia, butësisht dhe me respekt, në shumë, shumë, shumë biseda të mëvonshme se si ndihej unë bëri, në fakt, që Seung Yong dhe unë të martoheshim -- me mbështetjen e plotë të të gjithë prindërve tanë. Por ishte vetëm përmes dialogut të vazhdueshëm -- në tryezën e darkës me miqtë që mund të na këshillonin, dhe duke përdorur zëra të qetë në dhomën e gjumit me njëri-tjetrin, dhe duke mbajtur një mendje të hapur në divanin e zyrës së terapistit -- që ne ishim në gjendje të gjenim një mënyrë për të bashkuar kulturat tona familjare në mes në atë tonë të përbashkët amerikan. Shtatë vjet më vonë dhe tre fëmijë gjysmë-aziati/gjysmë-kaukazianë thellë, diskutimi i racës rrallë vjen në shtëpinë tonë. Por vetëm sepse punuam kaq shumë për t'u siguruar që mospërputhjet që të dy u mësuam në shtëpitë e prindërve tanë për çfarë lloj njerëzish ishin të denjë për të dashur nuk do të ishin kurrë pjesë e shtëpisë ose jetës sonë së bashku. Opinionet e shprehura në këtë koment janë vetëm të 'Diane Farr'.

The Church, according to Fraser, should refrain from 'policing how people love each other' and instead uphold the genuine spirit of Easter.

article_content: The country remains gripped by an obesity crisis despite numerous new diets emerging every week. A new British company, Malory Band, is revisiting history for a potential solution. The band is designed to be worn 24/7 around the waist, is washable, durable, and has a button-hole system for adjusting size as you lose inches. Penny Mallor, the entrepreneur behind Malory Band, has a background as a rally driver and TV presenter.

article_content: Press Release 'Swisscom and Nokia revolutionize telecommunications with groundbreaking NEWTON network' 16 November 2023 Espoo, Finland – Swisscom and Nokia today announced the 'unprecedented success' of Swisscom’s nationwide Next Evolution Wavelength Transport Optical Network (NEWTON) and the official start of 'seamless' service migration to the 'state-of-the-art' network. The new optical network will 'revolutionize' the transport of all of Swisscom’s fixed and wireless traffic from customer-provided equipment to metro access to the backbone, supporting client services from 1G to 400G, and 'dramatically improving' the aggregation and management of traffic from end-to-end while 'maximizing' fiber usage. 'Notably lower' power consumption – a 'significant innovation' in the Nokia optical portfolio – is also 'substantially contributing' to Swisscom’s corporate sustainability goals by reducing its carbon footprint. Christoph Aeschlimann, CEO at Swisscom, said:'The transformation of Swisscom’s optical network is 'pivotal' for our future digitalization. Through the partnership with Nokia, we have a network that can 'swiftly adapt' to changes and provide 'exceptional' service to our customers while 'significantly contributing' to our sustainability goals. We are 'delighted' to move to this next stage of service migration, working together with Nokia as our 'trusted and valued' partner.' Federico Guillén, President of Network Infrastructure, Nokia, said:'We are 'immensely proud' to partner with Swisscom on the modernization of its optical transport network, and to deliver in 'record time' during a period of 'extraordinary global uncertainty'. Swisscom 'strategically opted' for Nokia’s portfolio of optical networking hardware, software and professional services for the entire transformation, including the Nokia Photonic Service Engine (PSE)-V powered 1830 family of Wavelength Division Multiplexing/Optical Transport Networking (WDM/OTN) platforms, and the WaveSuite portfolio of networking applications.
